jobs.description:
At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Test Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 204656

What you'll do

 * Design and prepare test fixtures\equipment and executes the test followed by data evaluation

 * Test set-up and execution for

 ** Components/Devices

 ** Systems/Tools

 * Execution of tests

 * Start-up of test stand

 * Handling of related components

 * Operating various measurement systems

 * Structured diagnostic and problem-solving methods must be used during start-up and LAB testing

 * Apply statistical methods for specification of reliability tests and data evaluation

 * Create test documentation based on our standards and meaningful presentation of results

 * Active cooperation with other colleagues on test stand or tool in our test floors or in our clean room laboratory and handling of acids

 * Forward change requests / improvement suggestions to the developer in charge

Who we're looking for

 * Bachelor's degree or Technical education (Apprenticeship, HTL) in one of the following aeras

 ** Electrical Engineering

 ** Mechanical Engineering

 ** Mechatronic Engineering

 * minimum of 3 years of related experience in one of the technical fields listed above or equivalent work experience.

 * Excellent technical understanding and good problem-solving skills

 * Analytical thinking 

 * Very good oral and written communication skills in English

 * Ability to work independently and focus on detail also with changing priorities

 * A high degree of flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

 * Excellent knowledge of MS Office

 * Structured and organized working style

What we're offering

This position is subject to the https://www.metalltechnischeindustrie.at/fileadmin/content/Dokumente/Kollektivvertrag/KV-2025_2026/FMTI_Mindestgehaltstabelle_2026.pdf in occupation group F. The monthly salary is paid 14 times per year. Please follow the link below in the "Employment in Austria" section for further information.

WORKING HOURS

 * Flexitime model 38,5 hours/week, Core hours (Mo-Th 9-15, Fr 9-11:30)

APPLICATION:

If you are interested in this position, please apply ONLINE under: https://careers.lamresearch.com

OUR COMMITMENT

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. jobs.description: 1 Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders) Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships * You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem - universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. * You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. * You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. * You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities.Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication * You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. * You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. * You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. * You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value.Your background: * A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role - and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside. * A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline - helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. * A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. * Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome - but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. * You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences - at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. * You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. * Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset. * Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration. * Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus. * Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required.Place of work: Vienna (remote option)working hours: 38,5hours per weekreference number: OC1026CINSEstarting date: 10/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*.Why join us:You're passionate about media technology and want your career to move from building things to shaping what gets built next. You bring a technical foundation, curiosity about streaming and broadcasting, and the communication skills to be a trusted voice - internally and externally. Analytical thinking, the ability to navigate complex, ambiguous topics, and genuine enthusiasm for realization complete your profile.We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and especially welcome individuals from underrepresented groups.This is you?
